description: Complete evidence capture, storage, linking, and validation workflow. Evidence is first-class data in OnsitePro with legal-grade integrity requirements.
evidencePrinciple: If it cannot reasonably prove the claim, it is not evidence.

photo.description: Primary evidence type. Camera capture or gallery selection.
photo.priority: Highest — most common evidence on construction sites

note.description: Text-based evidence. Written observations or descriptions.

captureWorkflow.description: End-to-end flow from user action to stored evidence.

step1_initiate.trigger: User taps 'Add Evidence' / camera icon in context (daily report, snag, etc.)
step1_initiate.uxConstraint: Max 1 tap to reach capture. No navigation required.

autoCapture.deviceTimestamp: Captured at moment of photo creation
autoCapture.gpsCoordinates: Captured if available (never block on missing GPS)
autoCapture.exifData: Extracted and preserved from original file

userInput.description: Optional text description of what the photo shows

autoCapture.deviceTimestamp: Captured at moment of note creation

step3_clientProcessing.description: Processing that happens on the device before queuing for upload.

operations.name: EXIF extraction
operations.description: Extract EXIF metadata from photo and store separately

operations.name: Resolution validation
operations.onFail: Warn user: 'Photo may be too low quality for evidence.' Allow submission anyway.

operations.name: Hash generation
operations.description: Generate SHA-256 hash of the (possibly compressed) file content
operations.inputIs: Final file bytes after compression (if any)

operations.name: Dimension capture
operations.description: Record image width and height in pixels

step4_queue.description: Add evidence to offline sync queue.
actions: Store file blob in IndexedDB evidenceBlobs store
Create sync queue entry with all metadata
Show confirmation to user: 'Evidence saved. Will upload when online.'
Update UI: evidence appears in context with 'pending upload' indicator

queuePayload.contextId: UUID of linked entity (or null for general)

step5_upload.description: Upload file to server when online.
steps: 1. Retrieve blob from IndexedDB evidenceBlobs store
3. Receive permanent fileUrl from upload response
4. Call createEvidence backend function with fileUrl + all metadata
5. Server validates: syncActionId not already processed (idempotency)
6. Server creates Evidence record with serverTimestamp

checks.name: Idempotency check
checks.response: Return existing Evidence record (HTTP 200, not error)

checks.name: Permission check
checks.rule: User must be foreman assigned to siteId

checks.name: Context validation
checks.rule: If contextType+contextId provided, verify linked entity exists

checks.name: File integrity
checks.rule: Store fileHash for future tamper detection
checks.note: Server does not re-hash (trusts upload pipeline), but stores hash for audit

evidenceLinking.description: Evidence is linked to operational context via contextType and contextId.

dailyReport.when: Evidence captured during daily report creation flow
dailyReport.requirement: At least 1 evidence item recommended for daily report submission (warn, don't block)

snag.whenCreation: Evidence captured during snag creation (documents the issue)
snag.whenClosure: Evidence captured during snag closure (documents the resolution)
snag.requirement: Evidence REQUIRED for snag closure. Cannot close snag without resolution evidence.

checklist.requirement: Evidence REQUIRED for items marked requiresEvidence

general.when: Evidence captured outside specific workflow (general site evidence)

evidenceGating.description: Certain operations require evidence before they can complete.

gatingRules.gate: Warn if no evidence attached. Allow submission with explicit confirmation.
BLOCK if no evidence with contextType='snag' and contextId=snag.id exists
gatingRules.uxMessage: Resolution evidence required to close this snag.

gatingRules.gate: BLOCK if checklist items with requiresEvidence=true have no evidence

evidenceIntegrity.description: Rules ensuring evidence maintains legal-grade integrity.

immutability.rule: Evidence records are fully immutable after creation (except isArchived flag)
immutability.enforcement: Backend rejects all update operations on Evidence records
immutability.noEdits: File content, metadata, timestamps, and links cannot be modified

noDeletion.rule: Evidence cannot be deleted by any user role
noDeletion.archive: Admin can set isArchived=true with documented cause (logged in AuditLog)
noDeletion.physicalDeletion: Never. Even archived evidence remains in storage.

timestampIntegrity.deviceTimestamp: Captured on device at moment of creation
timestampIntegrity.serverTimestamp: Generated by server at moment of receipt
timestampIntegrity.clockDrift: Server logs both timestamps. Reconciliation is informational only — both timestamps are preserved.
timestampIntegrity.neverOverwritten: Neither timestamp can be modified after creation

fileIntegrity.hashOnUpload: SHA-256 hash generated client-side before upload
fileIntegrity.verificationUse: Can be used to verify file hasn't been tampered with in storage
fileIntegrity.reHashPolicy: Server may optionally re-hash on retrieval for verification (Phase 2+)

chainOfCustody.creator: Evidence.createdById records who captured it
chainOfCustody.site: Evidence.siteId records where it was captured
chainOfCustody.context: Evidence.contextType + contextId records why it was captured
chainOfCustody.time: deviceTimestamp + serverTimestamp record when it was captured
chainOfCustody.auditLog: Every Evidence creation logged in AuditLog

photos.exifPreservation: Must extract and store before any compression

clientSideWarnings.message: Photo quality may be too low for evidence purposes.
File too large. Will be compressed automatically.

clientSideWarnings.note: No warning shown — normal on construction sites

evidenceInContext.description: Evidence appears inline within the context it was captured for.

display.inDailyReport: Thumbnail gallery within report view, expandable
display.inSnag: Issue evidence shown on snag detail, resolution evidence shown separately
display.inChecklist: Evidence icons next to checklist items that require/have evidence

captureButton.placement: Prominent within each context (daily report form, snag form, etc.)
captureButton.uxPrinciple: Capturing evidence must never feel like extra work
